Confirm every downstream sheet references the live selection rather than a hardcoded scenario column — a mismatch here produces outputs that do not represent the scenario the model claims to be showing.

fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-generic.md's real_nominal_price_base_consistency test: Identify which sheets/figures use the regulatory real price base (e.g. "18/19 prices") and which use nominal terms, and confirm indexation/deflation is applied consistently wherever real and nominal figures are combined (e.g. combining a real cost base with a nominal cost of debt or nominal RAV additions without conversion is a material error).

label: Recompute closing RAV as opening RAV plus totex/capex additions less depreciation (and disposals if applicable) and confirm it ties to the RAV figure used elsewhere (return-on-RAV calculation, financeability ratios).
fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-generic.md's rav_rollforward_reconciliation test: Recompute closing RAV as opening RAV plus totex/capex additions less depreciation (and disposals if applicable) and confirm it ties to the RAV figure used elsewhere (return-on-RAV calculation, financeability ratios). Confirm which RAV base (opening, average, closing) is used for the return calculation and that this is applied consistently.

label: Sum the revenue building blocks (fast money, pass-through, depreciation, financing return, incentive adjustments) in `FinRatios RoRE decomposition` / `AR` and confirm they reconcile to the total allow
fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-generic.md's revenue_building_block_reconciliation test: Sum the revenue building blocks (fast money, pass-through, depreciation, financing return, incentive adjustments) in `FinRatios RoRE decomposition` / `AR` and confirm they reconcile to the total allowed/calculated revenue figure reported for the same period, for every scenario modelled.

label: Where cost of debt is shown as negative (plausible for real rates in some historic periods), confirm whether it is intended as a real or nominal figure, and confirm that same convention is applied con
fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-generic.md's cost_of_debt_sign_and_basis_check test: Where cost of debt is shown as negative (plausible for real rates in some historic periods), confirm whether it is intended as a real or nominal figure, and confirm that same convention is applied consistently everywhere the cost of debt feeds into revenue, interest cover ratios and RoRE.

label: Confirm that net debt, RAV and EBITDA figures used in `FinancialRatios`/`OutputSummary` ratios (FFO interest cover, net debt/RAV, net debt/EBITDA, debt/capitalisation) are drawn from the same period-e
fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-generic.md's financeability_ratio_base_consistency test: Confirm that net debt, RAV and EBITDA figures used in `FinancialRatios`/`OutputSummary` ratios (FFO interest cover, net debt/RAV, net debt/EBITDA, debt/capitalisation) are drawn from the same period-end convention (opening/average/closing) as used in `FinancialStatements`, rather than silently mixing conventions across ratios.

label: Confirm that the AIP (annual iteration / true-up) adjustment term calculated in `AR` for the prior period is correctly carried into the current period's allowed revenue exactly once — neither omitted
fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-generic.md's aip_true_up_adjustment_flow test: Confirm that the AIP (annual iteration / true-up) adjustment term calculated in `AR` for the prior period is correctly carried into the current period's allowed revenue exactly once — neither omitted nor double-counted.

label: Where a totex incentive/sharing-factor mechanism exists, confirm the totex figures feeding the incentive calculation (company proposal vs regulator determination) are drawn from the same scenario vint
fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-generic.md's totex_scenario_incentive_alignment test: Where a totex incentive/sharing-factor mechanism exists, confirm the totex figures feeding the incentive calculation (company proposal vs regulator determination) are drawn from the same scenario vintage as the "active" scenario selected elsewhere in the model, so the reported incentive outcome is internally consistent with the headline scenario.

label: Confirm the model clearly distinguishes notional gearing (used to calculate allowed return/financeability) from the company's actual gearing (used for actual financial-statement net debt), and that th
fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-generic.md's notional_vs_actual_gearing_distinction test: Confirm the model clearly distinguishes notional gearing (used to calculate allowed return/financeability) from the company's actual gearing (used for actual financial-statement net debt), and that these are not conflated anywhere cost of capital or RoRE is calculated.

label: Independently sum the components in `FinRatios RoRE decomposition` and confirm the total return matches the RoRE figure reported in `RoRE ranges` / `OutputSummary` for the same scenario and period — a
fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-generic.md's rore_decomposition_reconciles_to_allowed_revenue test: Independently sum the components in `FinRatios RoRE decomposition` and confirm the total return matches the RoRE figure reported in `RoRE ranges` / `OutputSummary` for the same scenario and period — a mismatch indicates either an omitted incentive term or a sign error in one of the components.

fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-generic.md's rating_scorecard_weighting_rationale test: Where a rating scorecard (`RatingSimulator`) is present, confirm any zero-weighted factors (e.g. factors not applicable to a system operator with no generation/fuel-diversity exposure) are deliberate choices consistent with the entity type and the disclosed rating methodology version, not an accidental omission.

label: Confirm pension deficit charges and business rates in `SystemOperator` are treated as pass-through/true-up items flowing directly into allowed revenue rather than being subjected to the totex incentiv
fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-generic.md's pension_and_business_rates_passthrough_treatment test: Confirm pension deficit charges and business rates in `SystemOperator` are treated as pass-through/true-up items flowing directly into allowed revenue rather than being subjected to the totex incentive mechanism, unless the model explicitly documents a different treatment.

label: Where `FinancialStatements` contains a balancing check row, confirm any non-zero residual is floating-point rounding noise (e.g.
fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-generic.md's balancing_check_row_materiality test: Where `FinancialStatements` contains a balancing check row, confirm any non-zero residual is floating-point rounding noise (e.g. of the order of 1e-9 or smaller relative to the balance sheet totals) rather than a genuine unreconciled imbalance, and flag it as a finding if the residual scales with input changes rather than remaining at floating-point noise level.
